nom: Pacifica Glow Baby Enzyme Face Scrub with Vitamin C & Glycolic Acid

avis.texte: I love this face scrub. It's very gentle and I have sensitive skin so I appreciate that. I see a difference in my skin after only a few uses. It's smoother and brighter. I highly recommend!

I had been using an expensive specialty exfoliating product which worked, but I decided I didn't need to be that fancy. I got this and it's effective and also gentle. I could only use my other one once a week and this one I could use everyday if I wanted. I like that I don't need any kind of scrubbing sponge with it, it works well on its own without being harsh.

This stuff was not coarse enough to do anything, exfoliation wise. It barely feels like a scrub at all. If you need a super gentle exfoliator, this will be great for you. I need a much more gritty face scrub though. Also, the smell is a weird, slightly sweet, kinda sickening smell. Not sure how to describe it.
There are barley any scrubbing elements in this product and the smell is awful—its smalles like clay/playdough.

avis.titre: The smell is not in line with the rest of the product line
avis.texte: I have found great results with glow baby products but this one is not joining my routine. The scrub seems to work well enough but the smell and feel is not aligned with other products so I will stick with my other physical exfoliation products.

i have textured skin and although i do use other products to try to combat this, a scrub is really helpful. it feels nice and doesnt feel like im rubbing tiny plastic balls all over my face like some brands have in their products. i havent used a scrub in a long time because of this. it doesnt smell like much of anything to me which i like as fragrance in products can be bad. would highly recommend, especially for the price and size.

I've used the Pacifica Glow Serum and the Brightening face wash in this line and I absolutely love them. I thought I'd give the face scrub a try too because I love a good physical exfoliant and it is awful. The other products in this line have an orange creamsicle type smell, but this face wash literally smells like v*mit with a hint of orange vanilla. The size of the beads was fine, but the ratio of beads to cream wasn't high enough for me, so I felt like I had to use a lot of product to get that exfoliating effect. At the end of the day, I couldn't get over the smell of using this product, so I had to throw it away.
I remember getting this in an Ipsy bag a while ago. I really loved it. Great scent and formula. I'm going to have to order it.

I used this with Earth Therapeutics Exfoliating Facial Mit. My face was brightened, a lot of pores go blured out, and overall it made my skin feel smoother and healthier. It smells like a typical vitamin c face product so Im unsure why folks are complaining about the smell. It does not smell bad. I noticed however it was mostly folks who got it shipped complaining about smell wheras i purchased it in store. Perhaps shipping causes issues with the product quality. Going to store this in my fridge.
I just got this in the mail and the package looked old. Still had the seal on but when I went to use it, it just smelled bad. Im definitely taking it back to the store and requesting a new one.
I like to use this once a week to smooth and brighten my skin. It works really well just be sure not to exfoliate too often.

I bought these when they were buy one get one 40% off (or something similar) because it seemed like a good deal and I've like Pacifica's eye shadow. Lesson learned! It smells strange, like vasoline and plastic. It also doesn't feel like it rinses off and leaves a weird film on your skin. Exfoliation beads are barely there. No enzymatic effects I can see or feel. All around terrible, every drug store face wash is better than this. Super disappointing.

I expected to see a difference in appearance of my skkin after consistently using this product until it was empty...but I honestly feel like it did nothing. I didn't enjoy using it due to its consistency, it spreads chunky on the face.

Blught this expecting an actual face scrub ans was highly disappointed. This had no "salt like" texture that I've grown to expect with a scrub. Also, using this was a major sttuggle for me sinple based on the smell. Unless I got a bad batch, this smells old.
I recently went on an Island vacation and bought a bunch of Pacifica's travel sized products to try. This was one of my favorites!
This is my go to face scrub. It's gentle and makes my skin feel so soft. Price is decent too.

I love the glow baby face scrub! As with all of the glow baby products, it smells great. The scrub is very fine and gentle yet effective. I have never had any irritation from this product and can use it several times a week with no issues. My skin is definitely smoother/has less noticeable texture after using this scrub.
I have super dry skin and it is very sensitive. This is not good for people with skin like mine because it will make your face burn and turn bright red.

I wanted a face scrub. I've used it a few times. I really like it! I have sensitive combination skin. It doesn't irritate. It brightens, hydrates, and smooths skin. It's gentle. Easy to use. Smells like oranges, Vitamin C, lightly fragranced. Clean ingredients, vegan, and C. F. Affordable. I rated it 4 stars because after use, my skin gets a little dry. Pacifica is a good brand! One of my favorite brands! Good purchase!

avis.titre: Great scent, gentle exfoliant, feeling good
avis.texte: The scrub and other products in this line smell so good!! Very sweet like cotton candy :) The exfoliant is soft on skin, and I haven't been using it for very long, but my face does feel pretty smooth. Can't speak too much to how effective it is yet, but I was very happy to recieve this with the free gift promo!

I received a sample of this product with my last order. Overall, I like it. My skin does not do well with AHA/BHA, however I still need exfoliation. This scrub is gentle and can be used often, it doesn't leave my skin sensitive and sunburned like other products. Just keep in mind is very light, so if you have many impurities or oily skin it may not be enough.

This was okay. At least it didn't dry my skin out. It has little scrubbing granular unit for exfoliating but very, very few. I received the scrub as part of a little kit I purchased. I only liked one thing in the entire kit. What happened to Pacifica and all the wonderful products they used to make?
Unfortunately I wouldn't know as I never actually received this in my order for some reason.
This gives my skin the smoothest result! I love it and will keep buying.

Ok , so Im using this product differently than directions say so be cautious doing this. Ive enjoyed using this scrub on a clean dry face, scrub it on then leaving it on like a mask for 5-10 min. (Absolutely wash it off when it starts to tingle) then hop in the shower or wash your face off (with cleanser if don't like how this feels after you rinse). Do this and enjoy butter soft skin after your exfoliating mask!

Every time I try something from the Glow Baby line I find another product to try and this is my most recent purchase. It's gentle and works with the other products to slough off the dull skin and my complexion is really brighter and clearer than it was before.

avis.titre: Good as a scrub but not for cleansing
avis.texte: I'm usually pretty happy with their products, but this one was so disappointing. It doesn't clean- as other comments have mentioned it didn't fully take make-up off, and it doesn't wash cleanly off. It has a greasy feel under the water which is left on my hands and face scrubber. This was not worth the purchase at all. Being back your foaming face wash!!
Smells like puke Why would they sell something to put on your face that smells that horrendous? I threw it away
Seems to work well but if you're sensitive to smells, I wouldn't recommend it. It definitely smells like puke to me too and I have to hold my breath while I use it.
Whoever posted a review that said the stuff smells like puke wasn't wrong. It smells terrible and I just had to return it because I can't wash my face with something that smells bad.
This isnt the best cleanser in the world, but its not the worst. I know scrubs get a bad rap, but i always scrub slowly and gently. I feel like this doesnt do much for my skin.
This was the free sample I was given and I love it. Not crazy about the smell, but the product is great. perfect amount of exfoliating without irritating or drying my skin out.
It smells very good, not too heavy. Have used only a couple times for this review, but I like it so far. It's helped with the scab/scaring of a pimple I had. I use it once a week.
This product is just amazing! It is so soft and gentle to the skin and leaves it bright and so soft! It also smells very nice.

This is my new favorite exfoliant. It's very gentle, so I could probably use it daily. The smell is citrusy but not overbearing. My skin definitely feels brighter after using it, but the scrub is not at all harsh. Highly recommend this product!

Love the smell and texture but I wish it has more exfoliants in it! I use it more as an "in shower" face mask. I wash my face at the beginning then apply it and leave it on throughout my entire shower. Skin is SMOOTH
I'm so happy I purchased this product. Definitely saw a difference in my skin tone & texture. A repeat purchase for me.
I enjoy using this scrub. It's not too harsh but still effective.
I really like the smell but I think there is something in it that I'm allergic to !

Love this enzyme scrub! I don't use it every day but maybe once or twice a week. I love the light citrus scent and the creaminess of it. It's a nice, light scrub that isn't irritating like others can be. It leaves my face feeling fresh and soft, not dried out.

avis.titre: Makes me smell like ice cream!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin and this cleanses my face well with no irritation. As soon as you lather it up it smells just like an Orange Creamsicle!!

avis.titre: Good for people with sensitive skin
avis.texte: This product was good, but it didn't really impress me. I felt like the scrub itself didn't work very well on my face, still I can see this being amazing if your skin sensitive at all! It was gentle, but a little too gentle for my liking. It smells great though!!

I sampled this product and loved the rosy glow that was achieved with this creamy citrus scented enzyme scrub. I have sensitive skin and most face scrubs are too gritty. Glow Baby Super Lit Enzyme Scrub exfoliated while soothing. Pairs great with the Glow Baby Super Lit SPF Lotion.
Great scent, great price and I feel like it brightens up my complexion after using it. Pacifica has great products so another win!

Calling all my sensitive skin girlies - this is THE face scrub for you! I'm so glad I tried this out and now it's a staple in my routine. I use it a couple times a week now, but used it every day starting out with no irritation on my very sensitive skin. It's gentle, cleans deeply, removes dead skin, and smells incredible! I adore the orange/vanilla creamsicle scent but I LOVE how soft my skin is after using this - give this one a try!
i cant get over the awfull smell, it smells so bad like puke or somethihng

Scrub as a soft exfoliant. I rub it on my face, let it sit while I shower, and rub it again before I rinse. Makes my face feel soft. The smell is yummy, like a creamsicle. Good addition to my routine.
This scrub has almost no grit material in it, so it does not effectively exfoliate my face. I will not purchase this product again.
Really nice scrub, gently exfoliates and leaves my skin absolutely glowing! Has a lovely light scent like an orange cream popsicle!

I like how this product feels on my skin and it makes my skin look great. The only thing I can't get behind is it smells like puke. I have to hold my breath while exfoliating around my nose. I just wish it had a better smell to it or no smell at all.

I love this scrub. I got it in exchange for writing a review, and I will definitely continue buying it when I run out. It smells great, and it's really gentle, so I can use it regularly with no irritation. Leaves my skin feeling great after using it.

Exfoliates well and doesn't dry out my skin! I have used it a handful of times now (every other day) and it gets rid of the little dry patches I get around healing blemishes but it isn't harsh at all.

Doesn't exfoliate at all and is basically just a cream. Does not do well taking off any excess buildup and doesn't foam up at all so cannot be used with typical facial scrubbers or applicators. Overall, a disappointment and not worth the money.

This scrub smells fantastic and is extremely creamy. I actually wish that it had a little more grit to it. However, I love that it has fruit enzymes in it. Fruit enzymes help to keep skin clear by breaking down the keratin that keeps older skin glued to your face.
I've been using this scrub for a few weeks and really like it. It smells amazing and it's the perfect blend of creamy and exfoliating.
Glow baby scrub is amazing! My face is so soft and the redness is less noticeable.
This is a nice light exfoliation scrub. It reminds me of a moisturizing lotion with very fine scrubbies. I use this product every morning in the shower. Great for every day use.

I wanted to love this. I really did. It has fruit enzymes and exfoliating beads and it sounds great. But it isn't my favorite scrub. I would buy it if it just had a little more grit (enough to feel like it's doing something). Instead, the texture is very creamy with spherical exfoliators.
The first scrub iver ever used that doesnt irritate my skin.I dont care for the smell but the benefits outweigh that so no biggie.

I received a sample product in exchange for an honest review so here it is. I'm not a fan of this scrub for a couple of reasons, the first is the exfoliant is too mild for my oily skin and second it's really creamy and leaves a residue that caused me to break out within the first couple of washes. I tried this as a daily cleanser and as a once a week cleanser in my normal routine and it's caused me to break out to the point I won't use it anymore.

I was given the opportunity to try this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion, and was thrilled since I planned on buying it anyway! Personally, I am a fan of the orange vanilla scent, and it doesn't linger long. The directions are a little vague as to whether this is meant to be used on damp or dry skin, so I have tried both. I feel like I get the best results by applying to dry skin and allow the enzymes to sort of "loosen" the dead skin cells for a few minutes, then massage gently until it begins to pill up and slough off the dead skin. Works great and no irritation on my sensitive skin. I didn't notice any signs of foaming when I rinse, so assume it is not meant to be a cleanser I do follow with a gentle cleanser to remove any residue that might cause me to break out. Skin is left smooth and glowing, no irritation, no breakouts, and makeup goes on very nicely after use.

I've used a scrub from a different brand for a couple years now and I was so satisfied that I thought I will never change it. When I got the offer to try this one I was low on mine so thought why not, it's the perfect timing, and Im so glad I did! I love everything about it, the texture, the subtle smell and how well it cleans my skin! I love it and bonus points…it only fraction of the price from the one I was using.
I ordered this for my daughter,she loves it! She says it has kept the acne from coming back,even the "monthly" acne. She loves how it makes her face look and feel.
I like the feel and it's not to harsh on the skin. Did not make my sensitive skin red and sensitive. Only thing is the smell, it doesn't smell bad but it's also not great.

avis.titre: Yes! This is an awesome exfoliant between facials!
avis.texte: I love this exfoliant because it's dual action and creamsicle scented!

A great way to instantly soften your skin. I use it on my face and body and my skin looks so much more youthful. Im in my 30s now n my skin can sometimes be life luster and need a boost and this just gives you exactly what you need. I love how its not too harsh or way too abrasive. I have pretty sever acne with sensitive skin and i use this every other day to get that perfect dewy soft skin. It even helps for your skincare to absorb better.

avis.titre: I don't like anything about this.
avis.texte: Terrible texture. I would prefer I finer exfoliant and a more cream/gel base. Also, I don't like the scent.

I'm giving this cleanser 4 stars because I'm not a fan of how difficult it was to rinse off. I liked the end result once I did, but it took forever to get the little "beads" off my skin. It almost leaves your skin a little bit oily as well.

This...is very creamy with little bits of exfoliating material. I have always had breakout-prone skin, so think more oily than normal skin. That means this creamy scrub didn't seem to really penetrate my skin's natural oils and exfoliate. However, that doesn't mean this isn't a good product. My mom has oily skin too, but as she is older, I want her to use a more gentle exfoliator scrub. So if you are looking for gentle, choose this. I am not, so I will be looking for a stronger option.
This is my go-to scrub! Immediately after use, my skin is brighter and more radiant. It doesn't feel harsh and the ingredients are clean. It's an affordable price point too which makes it perfect!

avis.titre: Great when part of your routine
avis.texte: A well needed scrub in the Pacifica collection. At first I wasn't so happy with the scrub. It wasn't doing much, but after a few weeks it has its place in my face wash routine and is a nice addition. Alone I wasn't too impressed with it, but after a face wash and followed by a serum or an astringent it's not too harsh of a scrub and does an ok job. It's worth the price but you need to wash with something first.

I was super excited for this product, but I didn't find it to do a good job exfoliating at all. It didn't remove any makeup (I only wear face cream and mascara, no concealer or foundation), which was annoying. I was hoping to feel like it scrubbed away a bit of dead skin & especially my face cream but instead it left me feeling dirty. Even just regular mascara which washes off with water was still stuck on under my eyes after I scrubbed this exfoliate on it. I used it twice hoping for better results, but just ended up having to rewash my face with the coconut face wash - which is amazing!!!

avis.titre: Glow baby products do make you glow!
avis.texte: I love this facial wash. It makes my skin glow and look refreshed. Your skin looks so smooth too.
Very gentle and leaves the face feelin smooth and lookin fresh. I'm loving this exfoliater, we needed this from Pacifica for a hot minute!
In love with this light face scrub. Not harsh at all nor stripping. It actually leaves my face feeling soft and plumped. This is going to be a repurchase for sure.
I can't get over the smell. When washing my face it smells like I'm rubbing puke all around my nose
